decisions.reason: Its dedicated product page and accumulated engineering investment create visible commitment, making a near-term withdrawal unlikely.
As the publicly announced flagship tied to the firm's direction, dropping it would strongly contradict prior commitments and sunk costs.
Although its website visibility is low, the integrated-slope element supports the announced low-profile direction and has sunk costs, so I keep it.
The dedicated launch statement and product page create public commitment, so the firm continues to treat weak results as temporary and keeps the line.
